integrity: The proof is analytic from the exact Weber-Hermite edge equations and standard Kummer asymptotics. Finite numerical checks were used only as corroboration and are not the proof.
limitations: Fixed n and fixed real gamma as a tends to infinity; no uniformity in growing n or gamma, no high-energy or full-spectrum classification.
title: Exact fixed-coupling low-band asymptotics for the harmonic Kronig–Penney model
